public_delta.note: Reuse compiled Form fields, source/generation guards and existing native/formatter/render writers. Callbacks are synchronous, plain functions with presentation-only unknown returns. Local Forms reject these options. No inverse-value mapper, setter, registration or lifecycle engine.

before_after.outcome: Run beforeBindValue with raw source and onBindValue with effective projected raw after the actual DOM writer. Undefined preserves the current projection; false/null/zero/empty string replace it. Reapply a changed after result once without recursively invoking hooks. Context supplies phase bind/val, nonnull RowId, raw values and primary bound element. Reject invalid callback options or missing Rows before ownership.
before_after.remaining: Global/local wrappers, unbound-key processing and wider row lifecycle compatibility remain required.

raw_ownership.outcome: Keep projection returns out of Form.read, Rows originals/status/changes, parsers, validators and committed field flags. Native constraints use detached raw probes, including custom validity only for the bound row. Enforce explicit native replacement shapes, typed option occurrences, scalar-array copy/freeze and async/unsupported-return errors even when automatic validation is disabled. Recheck cached explicit choices against current availability without replaying hooks.
raw_ownership.remaining: Business source normalization belongs in receive/decode/parse or explicit Rows writes; no inverse projection or implicit dataset mutation parity is claimed.

cache_focus.outcome: Cache only projection state by compiled field, RowId and sameJson raw value. Explicit bind forces bind; real reset changes use bind; successful updates/commits use val with new raw. Keep existing whole-row formatter/render reactivity. Read, validation, move/append, unrelated source values and focus-only repaint do not replay hooks. Focused editable text shows raw and defers callback pairs until blur; preserve unapplied pending reasons through unchanged resets and invalid drafts.
cache_focus.remaining: Explicit bind refreshes projections that depend on another field. This is not a generic reactive dependency or local raw-state engine.

lifecycle.outcome: Guard generation, source, row identity and disposal around hooks and writers, including freshness after formatter/renderer callbacks before DOM commit. During actual before/after value cycles, A-to-B may complete B while suppressing stale A; active same Field/RowId recursion fails with FORM_VALUE. Ordinary cached, null-bound or no-hook renderer recursion retains UI_RENDER. Before/after failures carry field/row/phase/callback/cause and permit fresh explicit retry. Null binding/removal/replacement clear state and the view without hooks. Disposal clears pending callback state, retains ordinary displayed values and restores authored renderer nodes through existing cleanup.
lifecycle.remaining: No whole-Form transaction or rollback of earlier DOM/Rows/application side effects is promised. Wider callback/row lifecycle closure remains open.

migration.outcome: Document legacy dataset-mutating bind/val callbacks and old-data setter-before behavior separately from modern presentation hooks. Use explicit application normalization and ordinary callback composition; native boolean/numeric controls remove old string-conversion workarounds. Exercise the current CVC detail through existing authored HTML and shared Rows.
migration.remaining: Legacy global/local wrappers, unbound row-key iteration and complete owner equivalence stay required; no historical source behavior is silently retired.

installed.outcome: Use one exact artifact in isolated JavaScript and TypeScript consumers and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit/actual Windows Chrome/Edge. Exercise new callback contracts, raw/projection separation, native validation and cleanup through existing public Form APIs; retain complete fresh browser coverage and original performance budgets.
installed.remaining: No publication/tag. Chromium may use proven built-in shards without skips/retries; actual macOS/iOS Safari remains excluded.
